name: Out-of-body hidden-target check (2 of 2: record and reveal)
summary: The second half of the hidden-target check: after the night's attempt (part 1 armed the target), write what you saw or felt and whether an out-of-body experience happened, then lock the response, rank the pictures and see the reveal. Record every night, including nights that ended in ordinary sleep.
setting: In bed or nearby, straight after the attempt or when you wake, before you look at the spare device or talk to anyone. The helmet stays on the shelf.
cautions: Don't look at the spare device before the reveal, and keep it face-up where it was until then. Rank the pictures before the reveal, even after a night without an OBE. Count every night you decided to count before the series.

sources.title: Connelly S (2004) The Psion's Handbook. PsiPog (summarised only; the licence forbids excerpts)
Monroe RA (1971) Journeys Out of the Body. Doubleday

steps.title: Record before the reveal
steps.instructions: Straight after any experience, or when you wake, write what you saw or felt. If you saw the shelf, describe the picture. If nothing happened, write "no OBE".

steps.title: Did it happen?
steps.instructions: Answer before you see any picture.

items.label: Did you have an out-of-body experience tonight? (0 = no, 1 = yes)

steps.title: Lock your response
steps.instructions: Pick tonight's trial from the list, then lock your response. Its fingerprint is stored, so it cannot be changed after the reveal.

steps.title: Rank the pictures
steps.instructions: Rank the pictures by how well they match your report, before the reveal.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.instructions: The helmet reveals the target and the app checks the commitment. Record the rank of the true target, whatever happened tonight.
